one_liner: Docs-grounded support chatbot builder where every answer cites its source or escalates to a human.
description: botsmith builds a support chatbot from your docs, helpdesk articles, and past tickets in about five minutes from a sitemap URL. Its guardrail layer forces every answer to carry citations to source passages; when retrieval confidence is low it refuses to improvise and hands off to a human instead of hallucinating. Embeds as a widget or plugs into existing helpdesks.
target_user: Support and product teams at SaaS companies with substantial docs

icp.who: Heads of support at SaaS companies with 100+ docs pages and rising ticket volume
icp.pain: Existing bots either deflect nothing or confidently invent wrong answers, which costs more trust than the tickets they save
icp.buying_trigger: A chatbot hallucination reaches a paying customer, or ticket volume forces a deflection initiative with a no-hallucination requirement

differentiators: Citation-forced answers: the bot cannot reply without linking the source passage
Confidence-gated escalation to human handoff instead of improvised answers
Five-minute setup from a sitemap URL, no training UI to babysit
proof_points: Resolves 61% of inbound chats end-to-end for design-tool customer Pixelhaven
100% of shipped answers carry source citations by construction
Median setup-to-first-answer time of 5 minutes from a sitemap URL

voice.sample_phrase: Every answer shows its source — or it doesn't ship.

signals: Named customer with published deflection metrics

gaps: Security page thin for enterprise buyers

confidence.notes: Citation guarantee is an architectural claim that is easy to spot-check. Deflection number comes from a single named customer.
